card.name: The word a after apply
card.fires_on: The word "a" right after "apply" or "working into" in directions for skin products, just before "thin layer", "thin film" or "full lather". It also fires weakly on "Apply" and on the space after "for" in massage timing.

modes.label: Apply a thin layer

modes.label: Working into a lather
modes.description: The article "a" after "working into" in cleanser directions, before "full lather".
modes.example: Massage gently into skin for 10-20 seconds, working into<< a>> full lather, rinse thoroughly and pat

card.writes: It pushes toward words for spreading or smearing a product, such as paint, paste and ointment-like terms (some in Chinese).
card.plain: It marks the spot in skin-product directions where the text says to put on "a" thin layer or work up a lather.
